assetUrl.description: The photo/video this comment is pinned to (`null` = the post as a whole).

attachmentUrl.description: Legacy single-attachment field, always `attachmentUrls[0]` (`null` if the comment has none) — kept so clients built before multi-attachment comments still render one. Distinct from `assetUrl` above.

attachmentUrls.description: Every photo/video the commenter uploaded as part of this comment itself (empty if none) — distinct from `assetUrl` above.

metadata.description:
Handler-owned payload for a comment a post-type handler created
on your behalf rather than one you wrote yourself — `null` for
every ordinary comment. A `TRIP` post's check-in:
`{ kind: "trip_checkin", checkinId, place, photoUrls }`. An `ALBUM`
post's photo contribution:
`{ kind: "album_photo", contributionId, photoUrls }` (its optional
caption rides on `content`). In both cases the correlation id
(`checkinId`/`contributionId`) is shared by every comment copy one
action creates (one per cross-post sibling group; a single-group
post's lone copy carries it too). You can never send this field
yourself when creating a comment.

reactions.description: Per-emoji reaction counts; only emojis with at least one reaction appear.
reactions.title: ReactionCounts
